text: literally got a 94 on the chem test?? me?? the girl who cried in the lab in september??
nobody sat with me at lunch again. i just went to the library and pretended i had work to do
mum read my diary. MY DIARY. im so done. locking everything now
three tests, a presentation and my driving theory all next week. my brain is soup
Zane said hi to me in the corridor. like actually said hi. ok i'm normal about it
wifi down all evening so i had to actually talk to my family lol. it was nice ngl
Uni offer from Leeds came through. Conditional, AAB. I screamed so loud the dog ran away.
got picked last for the team again. coach Rivera didnt even look at me
revised for six hours and still don't get integration. why is maths like this
exam season is over and i don't know what to do with myself. sitting in the garden doing nothing and its great
everyone in the group chat is going to Tia's party and i wasnt invited. found out from her story
First shift at the café. Spilled a latte on a man's shoes. He was nice about it. I will never recover.
Dad finally let me drive on the motorway. 70mph and my hands were sweating but I DID IT
too tired to even scroll. bed at 9 like a grandma
Ms Okafor wrote 'this is genuinely excellent' on my essay. putting it on my wall
woke up at 2pm, ate cereal, went back to bed. holiday mode
my best friend is moving to Canada. we found out today. i keep crying in the toilets
bus driver closed the door in my face AGAIN. third time this week. i was literally waving
Got my results. Passed everything. Mum hugged me for like a full minute. Grateful she pushed me tbh
history homework: done. room: tidy. me: suspiciously functional
Freya stopped replying after the thing at Jess's. I don't know what I did. Checking my phone every five minutes.
I hate being the new kid. Everyone already has their people. I'm just there.
Prom dress ordered!!! Midnight blue. Counting down the weeks
Lost my temper with my little brother and he cried. Felt horrible all evening. He's eight.
I think I'm actually ok with not getting into the team. I'd rather have my weekends. Weird but true.
Exam tomorrow. Revised enough I think. Going to bed early and trusting past me.
Teacher said my project 'shows real promise' and I might enter it in the regional fair. Already planning version two
so grateful for Amaya today. she noticed i was off and just sat with me at lunch without asking anything
Group project, I did all of it, they all get the same mark. Love that for me.
Got my first payslip from the café. £143.27. Felt like a millionaire for about ten seconds.
Can't stop thinking about whether I chose the wrong A levels. Everyone else seems so sure.
Gran came to watch my football match in the rain with a flask of tea. Scored. Pointed at her.
homework, chores, practice, more homework. its 11pm and i havent stopped since 7
The careers adviser asked what I want to be and I said 'happy' and she looked at me like I was broken.
Hoping the scholarship letter comes this week. checked the post twice today already
Mr Daniels gave me detention for something Kai did. He knows it was Kai. Absolutely fuming.
Thinking a lot about who I want to be at uni. Like a fresh start. Who is she?
Spent the whole day with the cousins at Nani's. Too much food, too much noise, perfect.
Dropped out of the play. Couldn't do rehearsals and work and school. Relieved and also gutted.
Ugh, everything is too much this term. Crying over a printer is not a normal response.
skipped breakfast, skipped lunch, revised through it. head is pounding. no energy left at all
Ollie asked me to the formal. I said yes before he even finished the sentence.
It's my 18th tomorrow and I feel like I should feel different. I don't. Just thinking about stuff.
Grateful for my bike. It's the only thing that gets me out of the house when everything's heavy.
I came out to Priya. She said 'I know, babe' and hugged me. Lightest I've ever felt.
Dad lost his job and now everything at home is tense. I'm trying to be invisible so I'm not another problem.
The geography trip was actually fun. Got soaked, saw a waterfall, Mr Hollis fell in a stream.
I'm the only one in my friend group without a part-time job and they're always talking about money and plans and I just nod
proud of myself for asking a question in the lecture hall with 200 people. voice cracked. didnt die
Year 13 is almost over and I'm going to miss this stupid building. Didn't expect that.
Revision timetable colour-coded and stuck on the wall. Ready-ish. Hopeful-ish.
My sister borrowed my hoodie without asking and got paint on it. The good hoodie.
First week at uni done. I've met people, I've cooked pasta, I've survived freshers. Pretty chuffed.
Too many open tabs, too many deadlines, too many group chats. I can't hold it all in my head.
Grateful to Mrs. Nwosu for letting me eat lunch in her classroom all year. She never asked why.
homesick tonight. halls are loud and everyone's out and i just want my mum's dal
cant believe the gig is next week!!! front row tickets!! Leon and i have been planning outfits for a month
Not stressed about the mocks at all. Which is weird. Probably means I should be.
Read my old year 7 diary. I was so worried about everything. Wish I could hug her.
Today: school, work, homework, sleep. Nothing happened. Fine.
Submitted my uni applications. Five choices. Clicked send and lay on the floor.
I'm so tired of pretending I'm fine at school. Everyone thinks I'm the funny one.
My counsellor, Joanne, said I'm doing better than I think. I want to believe her.
Saturday shift. Restocked the shelves, counted the till, home by six.
The bus home with headphones on and the sunset. Best ten minutes of the day.
Our robotics robot actually moved today. In a straight line! Mostly! Team went feral.
I keep comparing myself to Hana and it's making me miserable. She's not even trying to compete.
First proper argument with Mum about uni. She wants medicine. I want art. We both ended up crying.
thankful for my little sister's terrible jokes tonight. needed them
Nervous about the driving test on Thursday. Mum says I'm ready. My stomach disagrees.
